text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (May 22, 2025) for 301 Dixon Road .

The Property Standards Committee – Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (May 22, 2025) for 301 Dixon Road, Folder Number 25 162956 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension of time to June 30, 2026 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
